title: Goblet Squat
summary: A squat holding one dumbbell at your chest, an easy way to learn deep, upright squatting.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for quads (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly quads total.
Library rating 0.6 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.5 for adductors (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly adductors total.
Library rating 0.2 for abs: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.1 for upper back: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly upper back total.

setup.text: Hold a dumbbell upright at your chest with both hands.
Sit down between your hips, keeping your elbows inside your knees.
Go deep, then drive back up.

form_cues.cue: Use your elbows to nudge your knees out at the bottom.

mistakes.text: Letting the dumbbell pull your torso forward.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
